CI builds/tests on Java 21 and Node 24, requires the PostgreSQL concurrency suite to run (not silently skip), runs browser workflows, scans manifests/secrets and built images, and generates SBOMs. No cloud credentials or deployment are embedded.

Before enabling release automation, pin every action to a reviewed commit SHA, add formatter/static analysis/coverage/contract/security architecture gates and attest/sign immutable images. Create environment-scoped AWS OIDC roles (`id-token: write`, repository/environment trust, least privilege), protected dev/staging/production environments, private EKS runner access, and ECR registries. Publish SHA tags only after checks; deploy dev and run scripts/smoke.py, stage load/resilience/security validation, require production environment approval, use a reviewed Helm release and roll back on agreed metrics. These stages are intentionally not represented as fake successful jobs without real cloud configuration.
